today_in_history_posts.title: [BIP Proposal] Partially Signed Bitcoin Transaction (PSBT) format
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- A new binary transaction format is proposed to standardize unsigned transactions.
- This format will support offline signing by including all necessary data for signers.
- The design aims for easy future extensions and compatibility between different clients.

today_in_history_posts.title: BOLT 11, real time micro payments, and route redundancy
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- The writer queries the absence of a refund address in BOLT 11, unlike BIP 70.
- They discuss adapting fuel pumps for Lightning with the necessity for refund addresses.
- Concerns include feasibility of real-time micropayments and reliable delivery routes.

today_in_history_posts.title: Deflationary money is a Good Thing
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Passive and active investments differ fundamentally in management and engagement levels.
- Issues like the principal/agent problem can undermine passive investments' effectiveness.
- The article suggests stabilizing economies by blending inflationary and deflationary currencies.
